name: gauntlet
description: Gauntlet code review, run in process in Claude Code: /gauntlet [target] [--recipe <name>] [--lenses <a,b>] [--spec <file>]

linear_api_key.title: Linear API key
linear_api_key.description: Lets a review read the Linear issue its branch names (CM-123-…) as the change's requirements. Unset, the Mod uses LINEAR_API_KEY from Claude Code's environment, or skips Linear.
